paper.title: Systematic physicochemical characterization, carbon balance and cost of production analyses of activated carbons derived from (Co)-HTC of coal discards and sewage sludge for hydrogen storage applications

defaults.verified_by: Agent B (sonnet, independent re-extraction, 3 samples): BET SSA, total pore volume, skeletal density and H2 uptake (6.12/6.80/6.57 wt% at 35 bar & 77 K) all confirmed (triple-checked across tables/abstract/conclusion); dominant values chosen where the paper is internally inconsistent (AC-HCB SBET 2243.57 over 2242.63/2242.69). uptake_type=unspecified confirmed ('hydrogen adsorbed'/'maximum H2 uptake'; never excess/total). measurement_method=volumetric_sieverts with a cold/warm void-volume correction -> calibration point. 273 K isotherms correctly excluded (figure-only). Agent C adjudication: average_pore_diameter dropped -- Tables 4/6/8 give three irreconcilable values (30-40% spread) and AC-HCB's Table-6 value fails to reproduce from its own BET area and pore volume, so no reliable value exists.

notes.type: uptake_type=unspecified (exact-word rule): the paper labels these 'hydrogen adsorbed'/'maximum H2 uptake'/'hydrogen adsorption capacity' (Table 7); neither 'excess' nor 'total' is used for the reported values
notes.cond: maximum H2 uptake at 35 bar (=3.5 MPa) and 77 K (Table 7, abstract, conclusions); 273 K isotherms (Figs 8-9) are figure-only and not recorded
notes.method: H2 by the high-pressure volumetric method (HPVA, Micromeritics) with a closed-cycle cryo refrigerator at 77 K; 1-35 bar; degassed 373 K; H2 baseline N5.0 (99.999%); cold+warm volume measurement to avoid He capture in narrow pores -> void-volume correction -> calibration point by hand (tiering doc l.24)
notes.sa: surface_area_method=BET; total pore volume is the BET-adsorption total pore volume (single-point), so pore_volume_method=unspecified (corpus convention for single-point totals), probe N2
notes.dia: average_pore_diameter is NOT recorded: the paper gives three mutually inconsistent sets of average pore diameter -- Table 6 'BJH 4V/A' 36.6/34.2/32.2 A (3.66/3.42/3.22 nm), Table 8 2.75/2.64/2.33 nm, Table 4 2.75/2.56 nm -- that it never reconciles (a 30-40% spread), and AC-HCB's Table-6 value does not even reproduce from its own BET area and pore volume (4V/S computes ~2.46 nm vs the printed 3.22). Recording any single value would assert a precision the paper does not support, so the field is left empty (Agent B HYC-0048 adjudication)
notes.rho: skeletal_density from the He-pycnometer 'skeletal (apparent) density': 2228.35/2346.72/2319.63 kg/m3 = 2.228/2.347/2.320 g/cm3 (Table 6)
notes.ac: activated carbon from KOH chemical activation (KOH/HC 4:1, 800-850 C, 135 min) of a hydrochar made by (Co-)hydrothermal carbonization of coal discards/sewage sludge; class=activated_carbon, synthesis_method=chemical_activation; HCl 0.5 N wash for residual-alkali removal (purification)
notes.sbetnote: AC-HCB SBET is 2243.57 in Tables 5/6/10 and 2242.63/2242.69 elsewhere; the Table-6 value 2243.57 is recorded
notes.chahine: 77 K, 35 bar, unspecified type; 6.12-6.80 wt% at 2022-2299 m2/g sits at/above the simple excess Chahine estimate (~4.0-4.6 wt%) but near the established ~6.4-6.8 wt% 77 K ceiling for high-SA carbons (cf. HYC-0047), so recorded as reported and flagged, not physics-overridden

S1.label: AC-HCT
S1.material_description: activated carbon from KOH activation of coal-tailing hydrochar (HTC of coal tailing)
S1.activation_method: KOH chemical activation (KOH/hydrochar 4:1, 800-850 C, 135 min, N2); hydrochar precursor from (co-)hydrothermal carbonization
S1.purification_method: washed with 0.5 N HCl for residual-alkali removal then distilled water (centrifuge) to pH ~6

S2.label: AC-HCS
S2.material_description: activated carbon from KOH activation of coal-slurry hydrochar (HTC of coal slurry)
S2.activation_method: KOH chemical activation (KOH/hydrochar 4:1, 800-850 C, 135 min, N2); hydrochar precursor from (co-)hydrothermal carbonization
S2.purification_method: washed with 0.5 N HCl for residual-alkali removal then distilled water (centrifuge) to pH ~6

S3.label: AC-HCB
S3.material_description: activated carbon from KOH activation of the blended hydrochar (Co-HTC of coal discard + sewage sludge, 80:20)
S3.activation_method: KOH chemical activation (KOH/hydrochar 4:1, 800-850 C, 135 min, N2); hydrochar precursor from (co-)hydrothermal carbonization
S3.purification_method: washed with 0.5 N HCl for residual-alkali removal then distilled water (centrifuge) to pH ~6
